aliases: 8MP DeepinViewX Motorized Varifocal Bullet for Perimeter Protection

power.method: PoE (802.3at, Type 2, Class 4), max. 22.8W, or 12 VDC max. 19.2W

features: DeepinViewX 8MP motorized-varifocal bullet with dedicated large-scale AI model for perimeter protection (~90% fewer false alarms vs conventional AI cameras)
perimeter protection: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance, region exiting with human/vehicle target classification and combined-event triggering
AcuSeek search for humans and vehicles (requires AcuSeek NVR/servers)
hybrid supplement light: IR up to 80 m plus white light up to 60 m, smart supplement light
120 dB WDR, DarkFighter 2.0 low-light, blue-glass module, EIS
built-in front window heater (-H) for clear image in rain/snow, optional NEMA 4X anti-corrosion (-Y)
smart events: scene change, audio exception, defocus, loitering, people gathering, fast moving, parking, unattended baggage, object removal

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.

release_notes: 8MP DeepinViewX motorized-varifocal (-Z) bullet for perimeter protection, -H heater, -Y NEMA 4X. Specs (sensor, codecs, WDR, IP67/IK10, supplement light, power, storage, analytics) taken from the family /V-X(H)S(Y) datasheet; the -XZHSY motorized-lens datasheet is not yet published, so lens focal length / FOV / DORI / dimensions / weight are omitted (THIN on lens-specific numerics).
